status: Building agent-facing design tools — so a design leader can ship, not just direct.
currently: Recent work is in tooling for AI agents that touch design: UX audit and usability-testing skills that let an agent critique and test a live interface, design-system skills for scaffolding, linting, and syncing components, and a portable instruction set that renders one source of truth into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and GEMINI.md. The question underneath it all: what does it look like for a design leader to build with AI rather than just direct it?
